# Live2D Assets

This directory contains the local Live2D widget runtime and the Shizuku model used by the blog sidebar character.

- `L2Dwidget.min.js` and `L2Dwidget.0.min.js` are from `live2d-widget@3.1.4`.
- `shizuku/` is from `live2d-widget-model-shizuku@1.0.5`.
- Both packages declare `GPL-2.0` licensing.
- Upstream model repository: https://github.com/xiazeyu/live2d-widget-models
- Upstream widget package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/live2d-widget

The full GPL-2.0 text for the widget package is included in `LICENSE-live2d-widget.txt`. The Shizuku package metadata is preserved in `shizuku/package.json`.
